display.purpose: Topbar primary CTA only. Two instances in the system.

title.purpose: Panel headers, version modal title, card titles.

body.purpose: Default text, button labels, list rows. Max ~80ch before wrap.

label.purpose: Metadata labels, section captions, mode tabs.

micro.purpose: Chip / tag text, single-character axis labels. Never wraps.

mono.purpose: Terminal monitor, parser tokens, timeline data, version stamps. Reserved for data panes.

shadows.name: ambient-soft
shadows.purpose: Reserved for version modal and floating menu. Soft, low-contrast lift.

shadows.name: ambient-soft-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-theme counterpart of ambient-soft. Heavier alpha to read on near-black surfaces.

shadows.name: hover-soft
shadows.purpose: Transient hover lift on cards and primary buttons.

shadows.name: no-shadow-rest
shadows.purpose: Panels at rest. Defined explicitly so audits can confirm zero shadow on body cards.

motion.name: ease-default
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, focus, and panel-state transitions (~180ms).

motion.name: pulse-REC
motion.purpose: REC indicator pulse when timeline is recording.

motion.name: live-sweep
motion.purpose: Live data sweep along the timeline ribbon when bytes are flowing.

motion.name: reconnect-ribbon
motion.purpose: Reconnect ribbon pulse during auto-reconnect window.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Workhorse CTA. One per surface. Indigo bg, white text, 14px radius, 13px / 500.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">连接设备 | 当前未连接</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #5672cd; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3451b2; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(100, 108, 255, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #2a3f8a; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary[disabled] { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Sidekick action. Panel bg, ink text, 14px radius. Used for add chart, apply preset, open picker.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); color: #3c3c43; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.16); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.18s ease, color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.24); color: #3451b2; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(100, 108, 255, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Cancel / dismiss / system menu items. Transparent bg, whisper text, 14px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #67676c; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.18s ease, background 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #3c3c43; background: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.04); }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Square 32x32. Panel bg, whisper text, 14px radius. Theme switch / collapse / picker toggle.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); color: #67676c; width: 32px; height: 32px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.16); border-radius: 14px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; transition: color 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { color: #5672cd; border-color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.24); } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(100, 108, 255, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Accent-soft bg, accent-strong text, pill radius, 9px / 700 uppercase. Used for status indicators, mode labels.
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-block; background: rgba(100, 108, 255, 0.14); color: #3451b2; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Container card. 14px radius, panel bg, soft border, NO shadow at rest. 12px internal padding.
components.html:
设备连接管理
panel content
components.css: .ds-panel-card { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); color: #3c3c43; border: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.16); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; } .ds-panel-head { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-panel-body { color: #3c3c43; }

components.description: Standard input. Bg, 10px radius, 1px border, 6/10 padding, 13px body. Focus shifts border to accent.

components.name: Status Pill (Brand Block)
components.description: Signature component. The Workbench avatar. Pill radius, holds status dot + title + subtitle. Hover reveals connection summary.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84); border: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.16); border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #d97706; } .ds-status-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #3c3c43; } .ds-status-subtitle { font-size: 11px; color: #67676c; border-left: 1px solid rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.16); padding-left: 8px; } .ds-status-pill:hover { border-color: rgba(60, 60, 67, 0.24); }

narrative.overview:
The Workbench is never decorative. Every pixel either carries information or stays out of the way. The aesthetic vocabulary is 'iOS / macOS HIG, but for serial terminals': rounded cards on a clean surface, soft elevation, a single muted indigo accent that says active state without shouting. Density is engineered for a 14" laptop with two side-by-side panels, not a 32" monitor with room to breathe. Whitespace is a luxury; the Workbench would rather add a chip.

Brand voice is dry, declarative, action-first. Labels are verbs. The UI never explains itself twice — no help icons, no tooltips restating the button. Engineers read fast; the interface respects that.

Personality: quiet competence. Anti-references are AI-purple gradients, hero marketing copy, decorative animation, 'Designer Edition' typography.
keyCharacteristics: Operate-mode tool, not a landing page; visitor is here to do, not decide
Single accent color (muted indigo) used for active state and primary CTA; everything else is neutral
Soft, low-contrast elevation; surfaces float on a clean background, not on a dark canvas
Bilingual UI strings (zh-CN primary, en secondary), with font stack covering Segoe UI / PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei / Cascadia Code
Compact density with 10px grid; collapses to a single column at <=720px
Mono font reserved for terminal/data panes; UI chrome is sans
Status colors (warning / danger / signal) are reserved for state, never decoration

rules.name: The Indigo Rarity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent covers <=8% of any given screen. When the same indigo appears as both a primary CTA and a selected state, the design has failed at the IA level — collapse one into neutral first.

rules.name: The One Status Color Per Moment Rule
rules.body: At any given state, only one semantic color (warning / danger / signal) speaks. A button cannot be both warning and dangerous; the moment must pick.

rules.name: The Mono Reservation Rule
rules.body: Cascadia Code appears only inside data panels. UI chrome, button labels, panel titles — all sans. Mixing mono into chrome makes the data look less special and the chrome look busier.

rules.name: The Weight-Over-Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is communicated by font-weight (400 -> 500 -> 700 -> 800) more than by font-size (9 -> 11 -> 13 -> 16 -> 18). The size scale is narrow on purpose; engineers scan by weight, not by picking out the largest text.

rules.name: The Stable Header Rule
rules.body: The topbar never scrolls. The timeline ribbon stays fixed to the right of the brand block at all times — it's the Workbench's power button and the user's mental anchor.

rules.name: The Sidebar Equality Rule
rules.body: left-column and right-column are not 'main + sidebar'. The monitor has equal weight to the controls; neither column is decorative.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only as a response to state (hover, focus, modal, toast). A panel that 'floats' without a state reason is showing off.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted by the page background, not pure black on light surfaces. The light-theme shadow is a 10% gray; the dark-theme shadow is a 38% black.

dos: Do use the indigo accent for one and only one thing per surface.
Do prefer weight (500 -> 700 -> 800) over size changes for hierarchy.
Do use --font-mono for any byte, hex, or timestamp display.
Do keep all spacing on a 10px (or 5px half-step) grid.
Do use the panel-pattern (14px radius + 1px border, no shadow) for new card-like surfaces.
Do reserve warning / danger / signal colors for state, not decoration.
Do label actions as verbs. No noun-only buttons, no emoji-prefixed labels, no question-mark help icons next to obvious buttons.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color.
Don't use 1px black borders, hard 4px shadows, or any outlined Material look.
Don't add tooltips that restate the button.
Don't add a 32px display font for marketing flair in the workspace.
Don't mix mono into UI chrome.
Don't use AI-default purple gradients, glassmorphism on every surface, or infinite-loop micro-animations.
Don't ship a new component before checking it against DESIGN.md.
